title: github_releases tool not exposed in MCP session despite being implemented
description: github_releases is implemented in src/moeb/src/tools/github_releases.rs, registered in tools/mod.rs (line 97), and listed in the MCP parity list (line 177), but was absent from the Claude Code MCP session's deferred tool schema during run 3853e12f-99c2-4283-8161-76fa3cc6df2b. This forced use of WebFetch as an external tool to replicate the GitHub API + action.yml lookup logic, causing moeb-tool-origin to fail. The likely cause is that the Claude Code extension is serving a moeb binary predating commit 8608033 (feat(moeb): execute github-releases-tool specification).
proposed_resolution: Restart the Claude Code MCP extension with the latest compiled moeb binary so that github_releases appears in the MCP tool schema. Verify by checking that mcp__moeb__github_releases appears in the session's deferred tool list.
